primitive.relation: clique counts, three distinct views over upstream cliques at the full vertex set: Minor X174 x174_clique_count (every clique, the empty one included) equals GTBase.clique_counts.all_clique_count; Extremal D2tur clique_count and Minor X175 x175_clique_count (nonempty cliques) equal nonempty_clique_count; Extremal X88 x88_clique_count G r (cliques of size r) equals clique_count_size G r, and Extremal X4 x4_triangle_count equals clique_count_size G 3. Each is an unconditional cardinality equality with the corpus comprehension (in its own conjunction order), not a conversion; no equality between views is used (nonempty_clique_count G .+1 = all_clique_count G is an API fact, not a bridge).

all-cliques.note: #|[set S | cliqueb S]|, the empty clique included; cardinality equality with GTBase.clique_counts.all_clique_count

nonempty-cliques.note: #|[set S | cliqueb S && (S != set0)]|; cardinality equality with nonempty_clique_count

exact-size-cliques.note: X88 #|[set S | (#|S| == r) && cliqueb S]| for supplied r, and X4 at size 3 through its unchanged x4_triangle_set; cardinality equalities with clique_count_size

distinct_variants.GTMisc.conjectures.U13.is_max_clique: a predicate on vertex sets (a clique of size omega), not a count
distinct_variants.Chromatic.conjectures.X181.x181_maximal_: inclusion-maximal Boolean clique predicate with 1 < #|S|, not a count
distinct_variants.Packing.conjectures.XE1.xe1_maximal_cliq: inclusion-maximal clique predicate, not a count

upstream_audit.note: Pinned GraphTheory has the clique set (cliques) but no clique-count API; maxcliques are maximum-cardinality cliques and are not counted here. The three views are thin cardinalities of upstream cliques. Evidence: coordination/evidence/A17-clique-counts-discovery/ (upstream.txt) and coordination/evidence/A17-clique-counts/.
